text: {"headline":"Provider 1000000182 bills 99215 well above complexity-adjusted expectations in every complexity stratum, including low-complexity patients, but the documentation sample is too thin to confirm or refute upcoding.","leaning":"pattern_consistent_with_upcoding","interpretation":"A sicker panel does not explain this pattern: the 99215 share runs above the all-provider rate at every condition count, and the gap is widest among 1-condition patients. Low-complexity 99215s such as C0082018, C0082034 and C0082219 (single hypertension, I10 only) are the kind of visit where the top code is hard to justify. The records evidence is weaker. Only 8 documented 99215s came back, and their unsupported rate is only modestly above comparison providers. One low-complexity 99215 (C0082195) was documented at high MDM, while another (C0082028) fell short. The 6 notes claiming moderate-plus data review with no lab or test line on the claim are weak evidence that notes may not match what happened. A reviewer should first request charts for the sampled low-complexity 99215 claims and check whether MDM or time genuinely supports level 5. They should also look at the time_repeat signal and the data-reviewed mismatches."}
